scenario.irule:
when HTTP_REQUEST { set ::cleanup_ctx [ADAPT::context_create cleanup_ctx]; ADAPT::select $::cleanup_ctx /Common/cleanup-ivs }
when ADAPT_REQUEST_RESULT { set ::current [ADAPT::context_current]; set ::current_name [ADAPT::context_name $::current]; set ::before [ADAPT::result]; ADAPT::result bypass; ADAPT::context_delete_all; log local0. "current=$::current_name before=$::before remaining=[ADAPT::context_current]" }
